# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Note the date and time of the inspection.
3. Record the make, model, and serial number of the appliance.
4. Detail the checklist items and identify which component or function failed during the safety check.
5. Mention any visual defects or irregularities.
6. Document the exact nature of the failure (e.g., excessive resistance, loose connections, frayed cords).
7. Record the specific measurements or readings that were out of the acceptable range.
